text:
anne_pm: Quick sync — need alignment on sequencing Dedicated vs Private for the Q1 roadmap. Sales has two enterprise deals explicitly asking for Private (VPC + on-prem optional), infra is pushing Dedicated improvements for predictable capacity. Which prioritization framework do we use? RICE / Impact vs Effort?

devon_pm: RICE seems fine. Quick back-of-envelope: Private (Reach=5, Impact=9, Confidence=0.6, Effort=8) -> score = 5*9*0.6/8 = 3.375. Dedicated (Reach=20, Impact=6, Confidence=0.7, Effort=6) -> 20*6*0.7/6 = 14.0. So Dedicated numerically wins, but that ignores ARR from the two deals.

sam_eng: Important to call out tech delta: Private needs VPC peering/ENIs, KMS/HSM integration, audit log pipeline, and an offline upgrade path for on-prem. That's ~3-4 eng-months plus security review per customer. Dedicated is more infra work around node pools, autoscaler, and tenant routing — ~2 eng-months to make stable.

rita_sales: Two deals: FinRegCorp (regulated payments) and MediSys (healthcare). Combined ARR ~ $750k first-year, but both require Private deployment model for legal/compliance. Close timelines: FinRegCorp wants pilot by end of Q1; MediSys by mid-Q2.

leo_sre: From SRE POV Dedicated gives us a cleaner multi-tenant path and predictable throughput SLOs sooner. Private introduces blast-radius differences and support surface area — higher operational cost per-customer. We can mitigate with gating docs + runbooks, but that affects support bandwidth.

anne_pm: So tradeoffs: Dedicated = broader scale, lower per-deal ops, higher product-market reach. Private = big near-term ARR for specific regulated customers but more bespoke work. Proposal: two-track but with strict scoping: fast-track a Minimal Private offering for the two deals (VPC + KMS + audit logs only, no on-prem installer) while investing a smaller sprint into Dedicated tenancy. This hedges revenue risk and builds reusable pieces.

devon_pm: Agree on two-track if we constrain scope. Also recommend adding a simple scoring overlay: Strategic value (deal ARR + referenceability) to RICE for cases where RICE underweights big enterprise sellers.

sam_eng: If we go parallel we need to lock scope now. Suggest Private MLP = VPC peering, KMS, streaming audit logs, single-customer helm chart; exclude on-prem + HSM for now. Dedicated MLP = reserved GPU pools, tenant-aware routing, per-tenant metrics, autoscale policy. Deliverables should be measurable.

rita_sales: I'll confirm exact pilot dates and push to close FinRegCorp conditional on pilot acceptance. They will sign with 30% upfront if pilot starts in Q1.

anne_pm: Acceptance criteria notes: Private pilot = successful VPC integration + KMS key rotation test + audit logs visible in console + security questionnaire signed. Dedicated beta = stable tenant routing under 50 concurrent streams, cost dashboard, and SLA doc.

leo_sre: Ops playbooks + escalation path must be written before any customer pilot. I'll pair with sam_eng on that.

anne_pm: Action items: 1) Anne write RFC with scope + acceptance criteria by Fri (I'll include RICE + strategic overlay). 2) Sam + Leo estimate engineering and ops effort by Tues. 3) Rita confirm deal pilot windows by EOD tomorrow.

devon_pm: Tiny nit: let's capture confidence ranges in RFC so PM tradeoffs are explicit.

anne_pm: Good point — will include a confidence band and a suggested rollback plan for Private pilot. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
